mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies over Fireman's Park with a temperature of 25 degrees, feeling like 19 degrees. There is an ISS space station pass tonight, though cloud cover will prevent us from seeing it.

Property tax bills for the City of Verona will be mailed out by December 15th. Payments can be made in two installments, with the first due January 31st to the City Treasurer and the second due July 31st to Dane County. Options include paying online, by mail, or using the drop box at City Center.

Local events scheduled today include trivia options at Hop Haus brewing, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's or attend yoga at Insight Wellness.

In police updates, on Sunday, November 8th at 1:36 AM, officers responded to a single-vehicle crash on South Main Street where a car struck a curb, tree, and light pole before catching fire; the driver was arrested for an O W I.
Over at Culver's, today's flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open until 10:00 PM today, so drop by to enjoy a scoop.
